about: A plated plant-eating dinosaur with a spiked tail; it hoots softly and swings its tail with a whoosh.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A large plated herbivore dinosaur gives soft deep hooting moans, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur bellows a loud alarmed honking moan, three separate alarms with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur moans in pain, short hurt bellows, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large herbivore dinosaur sighs a long deep dying moan, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy spiked tail swings through the air and smashes: a deep whoosh and a crunching thwack, four separate swings with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Heavy footsteps of a large four-legged animal on earth: deep heavy padded thuds, well spaced. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
